name: item
useFor: Use for rows in a list a person scans or picks from: cards, agents, merchants, updates. Set aria-current or data-selected on the current row (it turns pale sky with a blue title). Use outline for a row that stands alone as a card, muted for a row on the gray ground, size sm or xs for dense lists, and ItemHeader or ItemFooter for a date or a tag.
constraints: More than two lines of description
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the guides' nav rows (agentcard-website .v7-guide-nav), the updates feed (/updates), the white key (.v7-btn) and the team page's photos (/about)
title: Item
description: A list row: a blue glyph in a small key or a square photo, a display-face title over a muted line, and actions at the right.
